prayerExcerpt.en-US: Whoever obeys and teaches the commandments of the Lord will be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Quem observar e ensinar os mandamentos do Senhor será chamado grande no Reino dos Céus.

meta.face: A spare Aragonese of about eighty-five, old but alert, with a pale complexion and a LONG face, broad at the temples and narrowing to the jaw — a high, bald forehead under the biretta, prominent cheekbones over softly hollowed cheeks, a long, strong, slightly hooked nose, large, bright, gentle grey-brown eyes under thin, high-arched white brows raised in the middle, deep smile lines at the eyes, a thin mouth parted in a faint, kind smile; a SHORT, neatly trimmed white beard and moustache close to the jaw; a warm, fatherly look. Not the stock white-bearded elder: the beard is short and trimmed, the face long and bright-eyed.
meta.basis: The portrait in the Prado, which we checked, shows him old, bald under a black biretta, with a long face, large arched-browed eyes, a short trimmed white beard and a faint smile, his hand on his breast. He died in Rome at ninety in 1648 and is buried at San Pantaleo, where his first free school for poor boys was.
